label: baseline
description: Gate baseline: work-package / skip-optional / robot + hot-resource probe, context_mode fresh. Recorded 2026-09-04 against workflows@95c299af. Delivery falls 54,981 characters from the previous recording of 1,428,459 at workflows@460aba43, to 1,373,478, and the corpus jump is one commit: the review-mode flag gains the starting value a session already knows. A work package either reviews an existing pull request or produces a new implementation, settled before the first activity runs, and the flag saying so carried no starting value — so every step gated on it met a gate with no answer and left the bundle to be fetched a round trip later. Twenty-one operations cross from fetched to bundled. get_technique falls from 27 calls to 6 and from 153,490 characters to 30,654; get_activity rises 67,831 to 657,606 carrying them; the walk ends 54,981 characters lighter and 21 round trips shorter. Delivered content keys rise 273 to 287, which is those operations arriving as addressable entries rather than as separate answers. get_workflow rises 24 for the declaration itself and get_resource is unchanged at 572,593: no newly bundled operation reads a resource the walk had not already fetched, and the resource ledger stays at 75 keys. The walk baseline records the other half of the same change — nine steps of the opening activity, and steps across six further activities, stop being recorded as reading a gate nothing had bound. Where this trades against a held context rather than a fresh one, and why the batch floor moves with it, is issue #603.
